remarks: Welcome to this entertainer's retreat in the desirable gated community of Godde Hill Estates in West Palmdale! Offering approximately 3,498 square feet of living space, this spacious 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home sits on an expansive 24,097-square-foot lot with an impressive blend of indoor and outdoor living. At the heart of the home is the beautifully redesigned kitchen, offering an inviting space for cooking, gathering, and creating lasting memories. The indoor bar adds another dimension to the home's entertainment appeal, providing the perfect setting for hosting friends and family.
